summary: Global Payments Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing an accelerated share repurchase (ASR) program to repurchase $500 million of its common stock, part of a previously announced board-approved repurchase plan. Approximately 5.74 million shares will be received on May 8, 2026, with final settlement expected by June 30, 2026. The total shares repurchased will be based on the average daily VWAP during the repurchase period, less a discount and subject to adjustments. This is a capital return event via an ASR, not a tender offer. Watch for the final share count and impact on EPS.
